acceptance_predicates.description: A linked tutorial covers setup, two compatible agents, catalog-advertised OpenRouter model, bounded workload, live result, report, and compare.
The ASB TUI/asb-tui install, setup, selection, launch, monitoring, report, compare, and recovery steps are linked and accurately scoped.
Supported distribution prerequisites and installation commands are documented from the pinned platform manifest with architecture and optional-tool boundaries.
Repository-owned privacy-safe screenshots or terminal images have alt text and text-only equivalents.
README, quickstarts, workflow index, tutorial contract, links, and executable examples remain consistent and validated.

definition_of_done: Exact reviewed documentation change is merged on protected main.
Independent documentation review and exact-head hosted checks pass.
Post-merge links and tutorial command validation pass.

inputs.description: Current ASB CLI/TUI workflow documentation and tutorial contract.
Pinned ASB platform and dependency manifests.

outputs.description: Linked two-agent OpenRouter and ASB TUI tutorial.
Privacy-safe tutorial visuals with accessible text alternatives.

gates.description: Tutorial contract, executable examples, and links pass.
Distribution dependency matrix matches pinned platform sources.
Visuals and transcripts contain no secrets/private paths and have text alternatives.
Exact-head documentation checks and independent review pass.
